faq.what-is: What is DodoDraft and how does it work?
faq.what-is-description: DodoDraft is an artificial intelligence-based text generator that creates unique job proposals tailored to your LinkedIn profile. It's commonly used to apply for freelance projects or job offers. You can choose to include or exclude your professional experiences, certifications, or languages in the context of your cover letter.
faq.differ: How does DodoDraft differ from other cover letter generators?
faq.differ-description: Have you ever spent hours crafting winning proposals for your clients or companies? DodoDraft's main goal is to save your time by creating unique job or project proposals that perfectly match your LinkedIn profile. Instead of generic proposals, we offer context-driven ones that align with the project and profile. Plus, you can exclude any irrelevant information such as unrelated job experiences or certifications.
faq.profile-publicly-description: Your profile is securely stored in our databases and is not shared with any external companies or clients for any reason.
faq.uploaded-stored: Is my uploaded LinkedIn profile stored in any file system?
faq.uploaded-stored-description: Your PDF profile is completely removed from our system once the information is extracted.

cover-letter.title: Cover letters examples
cover-letter.description: Below are some examples of the professional cover letters our tool can create for you

example-1.title: Angular & Material Design Front-end Assistance
example-1.content:
I am excited to apply for the Angular & Material Design front-end assistance project. With over 10+ years of experience as a senior software developer, I am confident in my ability to assist you with UI markup and deliver a high-quality web application.

Throughout my career, I have worked with various technologies, including NestJS, Rails, Angular, Redux, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL. I have a strong understanding of front-end development, and I am proficient in Angular, making me a perfect fit for this project.

I pride myself on my attention to detail and my commitment to delivering exceptional results. I have experience working on projects from scratch, as well as ongoing applications, and I am confident in my ability to refine the quick mockup based on Angular to match the original design.

Aside from my technical skills, I am a highly motivated individual who is always eager to expand my expertise by embracing new skills. I am a committed, responsible, friendly, and hardworking person who will go above and beyond to ensure the success of your project.

I am available to start immediately and would love the opportunity to discuss the project further. Please feel free to reach out to me at your convenience.

Thank you for considering my application.

example-2.title: Personal Executive Assistant
example-2.content:
I am writing to apply for the position of Personal Executive Assistant at Support Shepherd. With my strong background in research, schedule management, phone communication, document drafting, and general administrative tasks, I believe I am the ideal candidate for this role.

As an experienced Administradora de empresas with 4 years of experience in assisting with human resources management, project management, and quality, I possess the necessary skills and qualities to excel in this position. My ability to work well in a team, my constant willingness to learn, and my strong communication and interpersonal skills make me a valuable asset to any organization.

In addition to my relevant skills and experiences, I am highly motivated to expand my expertise by embracing new skills. Although I do not have specific experience in real estate, I am confident in my ability to quickly learn and adapt to new industries and tasks.

Furthermore, my bilingual customer service experience and previous roles as a personal assistant and executive assistant have provided me with a solid foundation in managing schedules, handling phone calls, drafting accurate documents, and performing administrative tasks.

I am proficient in using GSuite and Microsoft Office tools for calendar management, emails, and document collaboration. Additionally, I have basic design skills using Canva and Photoshop for creating visual materials. I am also familiar with AI tools like ChatGPT for content creation.

Although my English level is basic, I am committed to improving my language skills and I am confident that my strong work ethic and dedication will enable me to overcome any language barriers.

Thank you for considering my application. I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Support Shepherd and support your client in the technological and real estate industry. I am available for an interview at your convenience.

example-3.title: Payroll Coordinator
example-3.content:
I am writing to express my interest in the position of Payroll Coordinator. With my extensive experience in HR, particularly in compensation and benefits, payroll management, and HR systems, I believe I am a strong fit for this role.

Over the past 10 years, I have successfully led and implemented comprehensive HR strategies and projects in various industries, including pharmaceuticals, consumer goods, and energy. I have a proven track record of optimizing costs and increasing productivity through effective HR management.

My expertise includes managing national and regional payrolls for over 1500 employees, designing and adapting payroll policies, conducting salary studies, and implementing compensation and benefits models. I am skilled in creating dashboards and KPIs for data analysis using Excel, Power BI, and Python.

Throughout my career, I have held positions such as Andean HR Operations Lead, HR Payroll Manager, and Senior Payroll Specialist. These experiences have equipped me with a deep understanding of labor relations, union management, and HR analytics.

I hold a Master's degree in HR and have completed certifications in the latest Social Security regulations, Power BI for data analysis, and compensation and salary systems. Additionally, I have a strong educational background, including a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration.

I am highly motivated to expand my expertise and embrace new skills. I am confident that my analytical skills, decision-making abilities, and strong communication skills make me an ideal candidate for this position.

I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your organization's success and would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and experiences align with your needs. Thank you for considering my application.
